item.name: Government Coin Rules
item.description: Use government token. Set nonGovernmentToken from customer/seller login. 201 creates a pending rule; run 409 immediately after. No delete endpoint.
Customer token required; explicit location consent. Radius default5 max50km, approved only nearest first max50. nonCustomerToken must be valid seller/government token.
item.name: Nearby stores
AI service (Qwen3 4B)
item.description: Standalone FastAPI calling Ollama qwen3:4b. Configure aiBaseUrl and aiModel. Chat success requires model server and weights. Stateless, local only, no auth/tools/Search/DB yet. Provider error scenarios have individual setup instructions; do not run all mutually exclusive scenarios against a single server state.

exec: pm.test('App available in model mode', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({status:'ok', service:'ai-service', mode:'model'}); });

request.description: Requires running Ollama and configured model. Sends Thai greeting; output is generated, not a fixed mock. Normal chat returns storeIds:[]. Requires a valid CUSTOMER token and reachable Backend recommendation context before any model call.

exec: pm.test('Final model answer', function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.mode).to.eql('model'); pm.expect(body.model).to.eql(pm.variables.get('aiModel')); pm.expect(body.reply).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.reply).not.to.include('<think>'); pm.expect(body.reply).not.to.include('</think>'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('thinking'); });

item.name: Provider errors (separate scenario setup required)
item.description: See each request for setup; restore Ollama settings afterwards. Unit tests cover these using mock transport. No 401/403 or duplicate-mutation scenario applies to this local stateless service.

request.description: Stop Ollama, use an unused OLLAMA_BASE_URL, or configure a model absent from Ollama. Restart FastAPI after changing config. Requires a valid CUSTOMER token and reachable Backend recommendation context before any model call.

Use a controlled model stub that delays its response beyond OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS; restart FastAPI after changing config. A real model may also exceed this timeout. Requires a valid CUSTOMER token and reachable Backend recommendation context before any model call.

item.name: Invalid model response or upstream error (502)

request.description: Use a controlled model stub that returns HTTP 500, invalid JSON, or an empty assistant message; configure OLLAMA_BASE_URL to that stub and restart FastAPI. Requires a valid CUSTOMER token and reachable Backend recommendation context before any model call.

item.name: Recommend interpreted food or cafe (200, up to 3 new + 2 repeat)
Recommendation read tools
item.description: NestJS CUSTOMER-only reads. Login CUSTOMER saves token; List shop categories saves categoryId. No financial writes. Short groups are not filled from the other quota. Context is limited to 20 recent distinct shops; candidate visits use all-time confirmed history.
